environment.timedScope: Planner worker creation through all partition completion; includes worker/WASM initialization, planning and warmup. Excludes browser launch, initial page loading, pool-module import and builds.

scope: Integer objective, rounding-envelope recovery, equivalent encoding ablations, and joint-hard-resource dispatch; full browser workflows,4 workers, serialized

runs.coordinatorNote: Coordinator paused during current job and retired after job exit; browser computation completed uninterrupted. Further cases stopped after clear performance regressions.

selection.criterion: All-integer only if both hard cases sum improves >10% and MNK1.93 does not regress >10%; else simpler onehot. All focus cases must complete with correct values.

interpretation.correctness: No failures allowed. Rebuilt gear/materia/food/stats/damage independently; all complete results compared to independent known optima. Node passing is not a substitute for actual browser regressions.
interpretation.encodings: Same integer-feasible choices. Full-integrality variant stopped after failing the conservative50% time gate on P10. Ordinary regressions caused the first broad screen to stop early, not silently lose failed results.
interpretation.adoption: Passing target-case speed gates does not imply global dominance. Pure model regressions and remaining adaptive regressions must be disclosed. Not deployed.
interpretation.proof: Recovery closes a rounding-error envelope using the integer solver. This is not a formal independent verification of the solver entire branch-and-bound proof.
interpretation.timing: Same boundary as native baseline: worker initialization through all partitions, including planning; excludes browser/page/pool-module startup and builds. Censored results have only lower bounds.

interruptedCoordinator.note: Coordinator session disappeared after writing completed mnk-low output but before index append. Raw result preserved separately; reran as probe-resumed, not counted twice in timing matrix.
